0022600030.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, on a four-game losing streak) host the Toronto Raptors (4-4, coming off one loss) in the Bucks' 9th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Milwaukee is 1-3 at home and sits 5th in the Central, 5 games back, while Toronto is 4th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, and 5th in the East. Kam Jones is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for the Bucks, while the Raptors are missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), both out; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 122-94 loss in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
